entities.summary: Shimon Even was an Israeli computer science researcher. His main topics of interest included, algorithms, graph theory and cryptography. He was a member of the Computer Science Department at the Technion, since 1974. Shimon Even was the PhD advisor of Oded Goldreich, a prominent cryptographer.
